question: Who among the following at the US Open 2020 became the first Indian in the last seven years to enter the second round of a Grand Slam Singles event?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sumit Nagal__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sumit Nagal became the first Indian tennis player to win a round at a Grand Slam in seven years when he downed American Bradley
 
• Somdev Verman was the last Indian to win a main draw match, it was in 2013 when he beat Slovakia's Lukas Lacko
 
• Sumit Nangal is from Harayana, Jhajjar districts

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Prajnesh Gunneswaran** is an Indian tennis player.

 
 
• He has won 2 ATP Challenger and 8 ITF titles in singles and 1 ITF title in doubles.
 
 
 
• **Mukund Sasipisun** is an Indian tennis player.
 
 
• Sasipisun has a career high ATP singles ranking of 229 achieved on 17 October 2019.
 
 
 
• **Ramanathan Ramkumar **is an Indian professional tennis player.
